name: AppMySite
description_en:
AppMySite builds mobile apps from websites and stores, or from custom content without an existing website. Its product family includes separate WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify and web-view conversion paths, so the source system matters when evaluating compatibility.

The published build guides expose concrete release work: Android identity and signing, iOS certificates, device permissions and real-device testing. The platform can generate store-submission files, but the app owner still needs the appropriate developer accounts and store review.
description_zh:
AppMySite 可从网站和商店构建移动应用，也可在没有现有网站时创建自定义内容应用。产品家族区分 WordPress、WooCommerce、Shopify 和网页视图转换路径，评估兼容性时应先明确来源系统。

构建指南列出了真实发布工作：Android 标识与签名、iOS 证书、设备权限及真机测试。平台可生成商店提交文件，但应用所有者仍需相应开发者账户并通过商店审核。

core_features.explanation_en: Generate an APK for testing and an AAB for store submission after configuring identity and features.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置标识与功能后，生成用于测试的 APK 和用于提交商店的 AAB。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure the Bundle ID and supply matching certificate/profile information through documented automatic or manual paths.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置 Bundle ID，通过文档说明的自动或手动路径提供匹配的证书与描述文件。

en: Evaluate a content website’s Android conversion and login behavior.
Check migration prerequisites for an existing store listing.
zh: 评估内容网站的 Android 转换及登录行为。
检查现有商店应用的迁移前提。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose the correct product and prepare a non-production website or synthetic custom content.
steps.zh: 选定对应产品，准备非生产网站或模拟自定义内容。

steps.en: Check signing ownership, device permissions, build regeneration allowance and real-device behavior before purchasing publication support.
steps.zh: 购买发布支持前，核对签名归属、设备权限、重新构建额度及真机行为。

items.en: An app build is a submission artifact, not a store approval.
items.zh: 应用构建是提交产物，不代表商店审核通过。

items.en: Free does not include iOS store publishing.
items.zh: Free 不包含 iOS 商店发布。

pricing.summary_en: WordPress pricing lists Free and paid monthly, yearly and lifetime offers. Monthly Starter/Pro/Premium are $5/$19/$49; yearly equivalents are $4/$15/$39. Product type, publishing assistance and developer-account costs need separate confirmation.
pricing.summary_zh: WordPress 价格包含 Free 及月付、年付、Lifetime 付费方案。Starter／Pro／Premium 月付 $5／$19／$49，年付折算 $4／$15／$39。产品类型、发布协助和开发者账户成本需分别核对。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.en: Website conversion keeps the website as the source of content and functionality; custom-app creation follows a different path. Test the specific site’s mobile login and third-party services rather than assuming all browser behavior transfers unchanged. Some content/design updates can appear directly, while build-level changes require a new release.
sections.zh: 网站转换以网站为内容和功能来源，自定义应用使用不同路径。应测试具体网站的移动登录及第三方服务，不能假定所有浏览器行为原样适用。部分内容／设计更新可直接呈现，构建级变更则需要新版本。

sections.title_zh: 保留 Android 应用标识
sections.en: The migration workflow requests the existing package name, version details, key alias and keystore credentials. The package must match the Play Console listing. Confirm access to original signing materials before evaluating migration; creating a fresh package is not the same as updating an installed app.
sections.zh: 迁移流程要求现有包名、版本信息、密钥别名及 keystore 凭据，包名需与 Play Console 记录一致。评估迁移前应确认能取得原签名材料，新建包名不等于更新已安装应用。

sections.title_en: Review permissions in the generated build
sections.en: The Android guide exposes device-permission toggles and requires additional setup for notifications, social login and advertising. Enable only features the app uses, then install the APK and exercise both granted and denied permission paths before submitting the AAB.
sections.zh: Android 指南提供设备权限开关，通知、社交登录及广告还需额外配置。仅启用应用需要的功能，再安装 APK，分别检查允许和拒绝权限的路径后提交 AAB。

sections.title_en: Plan iOS identity and device support
sections.title_zh: 规划 iOS 标识与设备支持
sections.en: The Bundle ID must match the Apple developer account. The guide warns that enabling iPad support cannot be undone in later updates. Decide device coverage before building, and verify the identifier and provisioning profile together. Automated certificate generation still depends on account credentials; it is not account-free publishing.
sections.zh: Bundle ID 需与 Apple 开发者账户一致。指南提示启用 iPad 支持后不能在后续更新中移除，应在构建前确定设备范围，并一起核对标识和描述文件。自动生成证书仍依赖账户凭据，并非无需账户即可发布。

sections.title_en: Read Free as a bounded Android offer
sections.title_zh: 将 Free 理解为有边界的 Android 方案
sections.en: The Free guide describes one free Android build with branding and excludes Apple App Store publishing and premium features. Its broad introductory “all features” wording should be read alongside those explicit limits. Validate the number of regeneration attempts and the needed product’s entitlement before relying on a free release workflow.
sections.zh: Free 指南说明提供一个免费 Android 构建、带平台品牌，排除 Apple App Store 发布和高级功能。开头的宽泛“所有功能”措辞需要结合明确限制理解。依赖免费发布流程前，应核对可重新生成的次数及所选产品的权益。

sections.title_en: Keep product and billing period together
sections.title_zh: 同时记录产品与计费周期
sections.en: For WordPress conversion, the read page lists Free, Starter, Pro and Premium. Monthly cards show $5/$19/$49; annual cards show $4/$15/$39 per month paid yearly. Lifetime cards are separate one-time offers. These figures should not be reused as Shopify, agency or custom-app quotes.
sections.zh: 已读 WordPress 转换价格页列出 Free、Starter、Pro、Premium。月付卡片为 $5／$19／$49，年付折算每月 $4／$15／$39；Lifetime 为独立一次付款报价。不能将这些金额用作 Shopify、代理商或自定义应用报价。
